product_problem: 已验证的 planet contracts 仍没有安全、可跳过的 owner 接入路径；需要把纯 DTO 与生产 authority 明确分界。

seams.opt_in: 仅由 owner 提供 accepted checkpoint、seed/address 与 before/after CAS；资源池不 preload 或写入 Sim。
must_not: 把 lab receipt 当 capability 或签名
由 observation 推进时间或 epoch

seams.opt_in: 保持 standalone scene；未来只接只读 projection 或 owner-approved proposal preview。
must_not: 挂载 RP model 到 Main._ready
绕过 owner action/CAS 直接应用 settlement
改变 Main/Sim 启动顺序

seams.opt_in: 复制程序绘制配方或读取 canonical DTO，按 NEAREST/整数像素缩放绘制。
must_not: 把 lab cell codes 当 MapTile authority

seams.opt_in: 仅作 camera/focus/plane navigation；输入动作仍由 owner reducer 解释。
must_not: 把 focus/follow 当 gameplay transition
通过观察推进 route/epoch/covenant/recon state

seams.opt_in: owner 提供 accepted cargo checkpoint，资源池只生成 joint proposal。
must_not: 把 settlement receipt 当 unload/arrival proof

reusable_contracts: ScaleAddress canonical hierarchy and seed receipts
RP-0004/RP-0005 site scar and journal receipts
RP-0007 campaign directive and delayed delivery

verification_boundary.evidence: lab focused gates and canonical receipts only
verification_boundary.rollback: remove or ignore the additive matrix/receipt; no production state is changed

forbidden_crossings: aggregate anchor is not acceptance of any campaign or covenant transition
resource-pool validators never execute cross-owner CAS; owners return accepted before/after receipts
proposal receipts and hashes are not signatures, capabilities, authorization, or anti-cheat proof
lane owner scopes, checkpoints, and replay keys must remain distinct; one global Sim scope cannot replace them
stale closure never refunds fulfillment capacity automatically
projection, UI, camera, and inspection never advance epoch, route, recon, covenant, or settlement
RP-0010 does not read or deduct CargoManifest; cargo is only a transitive downstream owner concern
owner_handoff: Owner may adopt one seam at a time; first recommended seam is read-only projection plus externally accepted checkpoint validation, followed by a separately reviewed atomic CAS adapter.
